title: [Photo] Kim Sang-jun smashes first postseason at-bat hit

 2026년 11월 5일(목) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Sports Photos [Photo] Kim Sang-jun smashes first postseason at-bat hit 
 입력 2026.11.04. 22:40 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 
 On Nov. 4 at Suwon KT Wiz Park, Game 2 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korean Series between the KT Wiz and the Samsung Lions was played.
 After KT beat Samsung 8-7 in Game 1 the day before, Game 2 featured a starting matchup of KT's Ko Young-pyo and Samsung's Chris Paddack.
 In the top of the 12th inning in extras, with one out and a runner on first, Samsung's Kim Sang-jun hit a single and celebrated. 2026.11.04
